Name: Pet Manager - Follow and Fight
Author: aike4869
Description:
Description
Bring your pets along for the adventure! Pet Manager adds a dedicated menu for managing your pets and lets cats and dogs follow you and help fight monsters.
Main features
[list]
[*][b]Pet management:[/b] View friendship, location, petting and water bowl status. Rename, locate, favorite and change the appearance of individual pets.[/*]
[*][b]Follow and fight:[/b] Summon a cat or dog to follow you and assist in combat. Each player can have one companion at a time.[/*]
[*][b]Pet personalities:[/b] Dogs pounce and bite, while cats use quick claw attacks. A companion’s combat abilities grow with friendship and the owner’s combat level.[/*]
[*][b]Exploration:[/b] Companions move ahead of you in the Mines, Skull Cavern, Mutant Bug Lair and Volcano Dungeon. In other areas, they normally follow behind.[/*]
[*][b]Rest and recovery:[/b] Pets wander and roll around when you stop in a safe area. Their shared health and energy pool grows with friendship; an exhausted pet returns home to rest until the next day.[/*]
[*][b]Customization:[/b] Includes the Cream Lace dog appearance and supports compatible custom cat and dog sprite sheets.[/*]
[*][b]Accessibility:[/b] Supports mouse, keyboard and Xbox controller navigation, with English and Chinese interface text.[/*]
[/list]Other pet types can be managed through the menu, but only cats and dogs can follow and fight.
Requirements
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15[/b][/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] [b]4.1.8 or newer[/b][/*]
[/list]Installation
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the [b]PetManager[/b] folder from the download into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Open the paw tab in the game menu, or press [b]P[/b] while playing.[/*]
[/list]Multiplayer and compatibility
For multiplayer, all players should install the [b]same version[/b] of the mod. The host controls companion movement and combat.
The pet tab has been checked against UI Info Suite 2’s menu structure. Two-player gameplay and changing languages while the game is running still need further testing.
